assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Technical game-art production asset. The only visible shape is a short vertical rounded capsule in the same peach skin colors as the character's face, with a dark brown square-pixel outline. Top and bottom are softly rounded stepped pixel caps, completely painted for joint overlap. Use clear flat pixel clusters and only three peach shades, no realistic anatomy. Center this one simple sprite piece on transparent alpha. No hand, no fingers, no other limb segments, no clothes, no person, no labels, no background, no shadows, no glow, no extra items. It is a clean technical animation part, not a character illustration.
